links.comparator_used: Same GPT-5-chat prompt without the clinician-curated potassium dosing principles (relying on built-in knowledge)
links.outcome: Rate of appropriate potassium replacement recommendations versus clinician answers (errors, accuracy, potential harm severity)
links.effect: Total errors dropped from 165 to 104; average accuracy improved from 45% to 65%; notable reduction in harm severity scores with the dosing guidance document
links.tradeoff: Performance remained unfit for benchmarking; potential harm scores were still considerable in both groups; concurrent interventions and dosing still had the highest error rates; the model expressed high confidence for 100% of responses regardless of guidance.
links.quote: When given the potassium dosing guideline, total errors dropped from 165 to 104, and average accuracy improved from 45% to 65% with GPT-5-Chat.

design_hint: Providing clinician-curated dosing guidelines in the prompt (guideline grounding)
